reports.verdict: CVS raised 2026 profit guidance again, with Aetna's insurance margins recovering fastest, but management stays cautious about rising medical costs.

takeaways.label: Guidance raised again
takeaways.text: Full-year adjusted EPS is now at least $8.20, up from $7.90-$8.10. Expected cash from operations jumps to at least $15.5 billion from $11.5 billion.

takeaways.label: Aetna margin recovery
takeaways.text: Insurance profit rose to $912 million from $314 million. Medical costs fell to 91.3% of premiums from 92.8%, while membership shrank to 26.1 million from 26.7 million.

takeaways.label: Pharmacy outpaces benefits manager
takeaways.text: Retail pharmacy profit grew 10.6%, helped by Rite Aid prescription purchases. The drug-benefit unit's profit rose only 2.7% on 9.5% higher revenue, as client price cuts offset gains.

takeaways.label: Caution remains
takeaways.text: The raise still assumes elevated medical cost trends and possible economic headwinds, so management is not extrapolating the quarter's improvement into the rest of the year.

reports.verdict: Uber posted a fifth straight quarter of 20%+ bookings growth with record profit margins, and guided to another strong holiday quarter.

takeaways.label: Profit growing faster
takeaways.text: Gross bookings rose 20% to $59.8B, while adjusted earnings per share jumped 35% to $0.88. Operating profit hit a record 3.9% of bookings, up from 3.4%.

takeaways.label: Q4 guidance strong
takeaways.text: Uber guided Q4 bookings to $63.25B–$65.25B (18%–22% growth in constant currency) and adjusted EPS to $0.95–$0.99, up 34%–39%.

takeaways.label: Driverless rides scaling
takeaways.text: Management expects about 700 fully driverless vehicles on Uber by year-end and over 2,000 in 2027, shifting autonomy from pilots toward commercial rollout.

takeaways.label: Reporting changed
takeaways.text: Uber dropped adjusted EBITDA as its key profit measure in favor of operating profit and EPS. Reported revenue grew only 10%, with accounting changes to how some revenue is recorded cutting about 8 points.

reports.verdict: Profit is still falling about 15% and North America volumes keep shrinking; the raised full-year profit guidance comes from tax and other income, not better operations.

takeaways.label: Profit still sliding
takeaways.text: Adjusted operating income fell 15.2% to $939M on higher shipping and ingredient costs, bonus pay and advertising. Adjusted EPS of $0.53 compared with $0.61 a year earlier.

takeaways.label: Guidance raise is thin
takeaways.text: Profit outlook stays down 16-18%. The EPS range rose to $2.07-$2.13 from $2.03-$2.09, helped by a lower tax rate and more other income. The sales range's low end improved to down 1.25%.

takeaways.label: U.S. still weak
takeaways.text: North America sales fell 3.4%, with volume down 2.4% in meats, sauces and drinks. Segment profit fell 10.5%. Emerging markets organic sales rose 15.6%, but they are the smallest region.

takeaways.label: Headwinds in outlook
takeaways.text: Guidance builds in about $700M of extra brand spending, margins at the low end of the prior range, and roughly 100 basis points of sales drag from reduced SNAP food assistance. The planned split into two companies remains paused.

reports.verdict: Kodak grew on chemicals and added cash, but Print shrank 7% and profit fell short of last quarter's $36 million.

takeaways.label: Chemicals carry growth
takeaways.text: Advanced Materials & Chemicals revenue rose 21% to $99 million, and its operating profit (EBITDA) grew from $16 million to $21 million. It is now the company's most profitable unit.

takeaways.label: Print is weakening
takeaways.text: Print revenue fell 7% to $165 million, and its operating profit dropped from $8 million to $1 million. The CEO cited challenging economic conditions.

takeaways.label: Cash turned positive
takeaways.text: Cash rose $27 million in the quarter to $317 million, after falling last quarter. Operating cash flow is only break-even for the year, and inventory is up $44 million.

takeaways.label: Interest cost nearly gone
takeaways.text: Interest expense fell to $3 million from $18 million after the $101 million term loan repayment, lifting net income to $21 million from $13 million. Stock compensation was $8 million, up from $1 million.

reports.verdict: Shopify held 32% growth and a record 22% cash margin, but the first revenue miss in four years and a flat fourth-quarter outlook cooled enthusiasm.

takeaways.label: First revenue miss
takeaways.text: Revenue of $3.74B (up 32%) came in just under analyst estimates of about $3.75B, reportedly the first miss in about four years. Sales volume rose 29% to $119B, also slightly light.

takeaways.label: Cash margin flattered
takeaways.text: The 22% free cash flow margin included temporary boosts: a marketing test, tax timing and an accounting change. The Q4 guide is merely flat with last year's Q4, and Q4 spending steps up.

takeaways.label: Steady holiday outlook
takeaways.text: Q4 revenue growth is guided to the low thirties, matching Q3. Gross profit is guided to grow in the high twenties, and operating costs to run 29–30% of revenue.

takeaways.label: AI shopping still small
takeaways.text: Orders from AI-driven traffic rose 3.3x, but management called volume small. Shopify also paid about $100M for Shop.com and is spending more on AI tools.

reports.verdict: Teva's brand drugs are growing fast enough to lift 2026 guidance again, even as generic Revlimid competition cuts generics sales sharply.

takeaways.label: Guidance raised again
takeaways.text: 2026 revenue outlook rises to $16.7–17.0 billion, from $16.5–16.85 billion. Austedo is now $2.55–2.65 billion, up from $2.45–2.6 billion; Ajovy and Uzedy were also raised.

takeaways.label: Brands offset generics
takeaways.text: Key brand drugs grew 33% to about $1.1 billion. U.S. generic sales fell 39% to $718 million on competition for generic Revlimid, leaving total revenue down 2% at $4.4 billion.

takeaways.label: Profit and margins improved
takeaways.text: Adjusted earnings per share were $0.86, up 10%, and gross margin rose to 55.5% from 51.4%. Free cash flow was $495 million, slightly below last year.

takeaways.label: New injectable approved
takeaways.text: The FDA approved Weltruza, a once-monthly schizophrenia injection, on Oct. 9. Teva sees $1.5–2.0 billion peak sales for it and Uzedy together. A Parkinson's-type disease (MSA) trial was stopped as futile.

reports.verdict: Pfizer beat expectations and raised 2026 guidance, but a pricing boost for Eliquis and rising R&D spending carry much of the story.

takeaways.label: Beat and raise
takeaways.text: Adjusted EPS of $0.87 beat the roughly $0.73 expected. Full-year revenue guidance rose $1.5B to $62-64B, and EPS guidance rose to $2.95-$3.05 despite a $0.10 licensing charge.

takeaways.label: Eliquis price-driven
takeaways.text: Eliquis sales jumped 25% to $2.52B, mainly from lower rebates and a favorable channel mix in the U.S. rather than demand alone, which may be hard to repeat.

takeaways.label: Newer drugs offset COVID
takeaways.text: Total revenue was flat at $16.6B. Paxlovid fell 63% and Comirnaty 29%, but launched and acquired products grew 32% and non-COVID sales grew 7%.

takeaways.label: Spending rising
takeaways.text: R&D rose 18% on obesity and cancer programs, and the R&D guide went up $300M. A $650M Innovent licensing deal was booked. No share buybacks are planned in 2026.

reports.verdict: AMD guided fourth-quarter revenue to about $17 billion, up roughly 27% from the third quarter, as its new AI racks begin shipping in volume.

takeaways.label: Data center surge
takeaways.text: Revenue rose 45% to $13.4B. Data center sales jumped 97% to $8.5B, helped by the launch of the MI450 AI chips. PC and gaming sales fell 8%.

takeaways.label: Huge Q4 guide
takeaways.text: Fourth-quarter revenue is guided to about $17B, plus or minus 3%, with AMD saying growth will speed up as it scales Helios AI racks and 'Venice' server chips.

takeaways.label: Margin slips
takeaways.text: Adjusted gross margin was 56% in Q3 but is guided to about 55% for Q4, so the margin falls a point even as revenue jumps.

takeaways.label: Cash flow thinning
takeaways.text: Free cash flow fell to $554M from $1.56B in Q2. Inventory rose to $11.5B and debt more than doubled to $7.1B from $3.2B.

reports.verdict: Refining profits hit another record on war-inflated margins, and management expects them to stay high through mid-2027 while it sells two refineries for cash.

takeaways.label: Record margins again
takeaways.text: Profit per barrel refined jumped to $45.70 from $17.60 a year ago. Adjusted earnings were $26.93 a share, above the roughly $24.5 analysts expected.

takeaways.label: Margins seen lasting
takeaways.text: Management expects elevated margins through at least mid-2027, citing about 10 million barrels a day of global refining capacity offline, and says it has seen no demand destruction.

takeaways.label: Selling two refineries
takeaways.text: Marathon is selling its St. Paul Park and Mandan refineries to CVR Energy for $4.2 billion, with $3.45 billion going to Marathon. Proceeds go mainly to the Gulf Coast.

takeaways.label: Heavy cash return
takeaways.text: Marathon returned $3.3 billion in the quarter, raised its dividend 10% and added a $5 billion buyback authorization. It holds $13.6 billion in cash.

reports.verdict: Record quarter, but Apple guided December gross margin down to 45%–46% as memory costs climb, and gave no outlook past that.

takeaways.label: Margins squeezed by memory
takeaways.text: December-quarter gross margin is guided to 45%–46%, below the 47.9% just reported (about 1 point of which came from tariff refunds) and below the 46.3% analysts expected. Memory prices are still rising.

takeaways.label: Growth slowing
takeaways.text: December-quarter revenue is guided up 7%–10%, down from 12% this quarter. Services is guided up 8%–9%. Mac and iPad supply stays limited by memory availability.

takeaways.label: AI spending climbing
takeaways.text: Operating expenses are expected to rise 11%–13% next quarter on AI investment. R&D already jumped about 32% to $11.7 billion in the September quarter.

takeaways.label: Strong quarter and year
takeaways.text: Revenue was $114.5 billion (up 12%) and EPS $2.10, both September-quarter records. iPhone grew 17% to $57.6 billion and Greater China grew 21%. Full-year revenue hit $479 billion.

reports.verdict: Palantir's revenue nearly doubled again and U.S. commercial sales passed government for the first time, but new contract signings are growing far slower than sales.

takeaways.label: Commercial overtakes government
takeaways.text: U.S. commercial revenue rose 148% to $984M, passing U.S. government revenue ($953M, up 96%) for the first time. Total revenue topped $2B, up 96% to $2.31B.

takeaways.label: Guidance raised sharply
takeaways.text: Full-year revenue outlook rose to about $8.53B, roughly 91% growth, from $8.15B. Q4 is guided to about $2.65B, with adjusted operating margin near 62%.

takeaways.label: Bookings lag revenue
takeaways.text: New U.S. commercial contract value grew only 11% to $1.46B, and total contract value grew 6%. Management said several large deals had shorter terms than usual.

takeaways.label: Land-and-expand accelerating
takeaways.text: Pilots are turning into much larger deals, for example $3M to $29M annual value. Customers who stay spend 65% more each year (net retention 165%).
